8:1.questionTextEn: What is the scientific process of carefully observing an object or event to collect information?
8:1.answerEn: Observation is the careful collection of information using senses or instruments.
8:1.originalQuestionNe: वैज्ञानिक अध्ययनमा कुनै वस्तु वा घटनालाई ध्यानपूर्वक हेरी तथ्य सङ्कलन गर्ने प्रक्रियालाई के भनिन्छ?

8:2.questionTextEn: Which online service helps people search for information on websites?
8:2.answerEn: A search engine helps find web pages and online information.
8:2.originalQuestionNe: वेबसाइट वा इन्टरनेटमा सूचना खोज्न प्रयोग गरिने सेवाको उदाहरण कुन हो?

8:3.questionTextEn: What is the basic structural and functional unit of living organisms?
8:3.answerEn: The cell is the basic structural and functional unit of living organisms.
8:3.originalQuestionNe: सजीवको संरचनात्मक तथा कार्यात्मक आधारभूत एकाइ कुन हो?

8:4.questionTextEn: What is a system of interactions between living and non-living components of an area called?
8:4.answerEn: An ecosystem consists of interacting living and non-living components.
8:4.originalQuestionNe: कुनै क्षेत्रमा रहेका सजीव र निर्जीव तत्वबीचको अन्तरसम्बन्धित प्रणालीलाई के भनिन्छ?

8:5.questionTextEn: What is the process by which green plants make their own food called?
8:5.answerEn: Green plants make food by photosynthesis using light, water and carbon dioxide.
8:5.originalQuestionNe: हरिया बिरुवाले आफ्नै खाना बनाउने प्रक्रियालाई के भनिन्छ?

8:6.questionTextEn: What is a push or pull that can change the motion or shape of an object called?
8:6.answerEn: A force is a push or pull that can change an object's motion or shape.
8:6.originalQuestionNe: वस्तुको गति वा आकार परिवर्तन गराउन सक्ने धक्कालाई के भनिन्छ?

8:7.questionTextEn: Which form of energy is mainly stored in the cooking gas used as fuel?
8:7.answerEn: Fuel stores chemical energy that is released during combustion.
8:7.originalQuestionNe: खाना पकाउन प्रयोग हुने ग्यासमा मुख्यतः कुन प्रकारको ऊर्जा सञ्चित हुन्छ?

8:8.questionTextEn: Under which condition can electric current flow through a circuit?
8:8.answerEn: A complete or closed conducting path allows current to flow.
8:8.originalQuestionNe: विद्युत् परिपथ पूरा हुँदा विद्युत् धारा बग्ने अवस्था कुन हो?

8:9.questionTextEn: What is a pure substance formed by the chemical combination of two or more elements in a fixed ratio?
8:9.answerEn: A compound contains chemically combined elements in a fixed proportion.
8:9.originalQuestionNe: दुई वा दुईभन्दा बढी तत्व निश्चित अनुपातमा रासायनिक रूपमा मिलेर बनेको शुद्ध पदार्थ कुन हो?

8:10.questionTextEn: Which two conditions are mainly needed for iron to rust?
8:10.answerEn: Rust forms when iron reacts in the presence of oxygen and moisture.
8:10.originalQuestionNe: फलाममा खिया लाग्न मुख्यतः कुन दुई कुराको उपस्थिति आवश्यक हुन्छ?

8:11.questionTextEn: Approximately how long does the Earth take to complete one revolution around the Sun?
8:11.answerEn: The Earth completes one revolution in approximately 365 days and 6 hours.
8:11.originalQuestionNe: पृथ्वीले सूर्यको एक परिक्रमा पूरा गर्न लगभग कति समय लगाउँछ?

optionsEn: A possible explanation that can be tested
10:1.answerEn: A hypothesis is a testable possible explanation.

10:2.questionTextEn: What is mainly considered in the modern classification of living organisms?
10:2.answerEn: Modern classification uses shared characteristics and evolutionary relationships.
10:2.originalQuestionNe: आधुनिक वर्गीकरणमा मुख्यतः कुन आधार प्रयोग गरिन्छ?

10:3.questionTextEn: Which member of a honeybee colony is primarily responsible for laying eggs?
10:3.answerEn: The queen bee primarily lays eggs in the colony.
10:3.originalQuestionNe: घारमा अण्डा पार्ने मुख्य मौरी कुन हो?

10:4.questionTextEn: Where is hereditary information mainly stored?
10:4.answerEn: Genes in DNA carry hereditary information.

10:5.questionTextEn: Which organ pumps blood through the human body?
10:5.answerEn: The heart pumps blood throughout the body.
10:5.originalQuestionNe: मानव शरीरमा रगत पम्प गर्ने अङ्ग कुन हो?

10:6.questionTextEn: Which is a producer in a food chain?
10:6.answerEn: Green plants produce food through photosynthesis.

10:7.questionTextEn: What is the SI unit of velocity?
10:7.answerEn: The SI unit of velocity is metres per second (m/s).

10:8.questionTextEn: What is the SI unit of pressure?
10:8.answerEn: The SI unit of pressure is pascal (Pa), equal to N/m².

10:9.answerEn: A thermometer is used to measure temperature.
10:9.originalQuestionNe: तापक्रम मापन गर्ने उपकरण कुन हो?

10:10.questionTextEn: What type of wave is sound?
10:10.answerEn: Sound is a mechanical wave and requires a medium to propagate.

10:11.questionTextEn: What is the SI unit of electric current?
10:11.answerEn: The SI unit of electric current is ampere (A).
10:11.originalQuestionNe: विद्युत् धाराको SI एकाइ कुन हो?

10:12.questionTextEn: Which celestial body is at the centre of our solar system?
10:12.answerEn: The Sun is at the centre of the solar system.

10:13.questionTextEn: What is the term for the address of a resource on the web?
10:13.answerEn: A URL identifies the address of a web resource.
10:13.originalQuestionNe: वेबसाइटको ठेगाना जनाउने प्रणाली कुन हो?

10:14.questionTextEn: On which basis are elements arranged in the modern periodic table?
10:14.answerEn: The modern periodic table is arranged by increasing atomic number.
10:14.originalQuestionNe: आधुनिक आवर्त सारणी कुन आधारमा क्रमबद्ध छ?

10:15.questionTextEn: What is formed from reactants during a chemical reaction?
10:15.answerEn: Chemical reactions convert reactants into products.

10:16.questionTextEn: What is the role of oxygen in combustion?
10:16.answerEn: Oxygen supports the combustion of fuels.

10:17.answerEn: Mercury is liquid at ordinary room temperature.

10:19.questionTextEn: How does soap help to remove greasy dirt?
optionsEn: Its molecules interact with both oil and water
10:19.answerEn: Soap molecules have parts that interact with water and oily substances.
